scalars.scalar_value: 3 to 5 years of clinical experience within Critical Care and/or Emergency Services

items.item_text: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the State of California
Certified as a Basic Life Support Instructor - American Heart Association
Must sit for professional certification within one year of entering the position (within 12 months from date of hire)
Must obtain a professional certification within two years after entering the position (within 24 months from date of hire)
3 to 5 years of clinical experience within Critical Care and/or Emergency Services

Strategic Educational Leadership: Conduct annual needs assessments in collaboration with Critical Care and ED leadership to design, implement, and evaluate high-impact educational programs that align with organizational goals and patient safety mandates.

Clinical Skill Development & Mentorship: Facilitate comprehensive onboarding, ongoing specialty training, and high-risk competency validations (e.g., mock codes, airway management) using evidence-based practice and adult learning principles.

Quality & Safety Oversight: Drive the implementation of critical care and ED safety initiatives, monitoring compliance with regulatory requirements and reporting data-driven outcomes to clinical and administrative leadership.

Performance Improvement & Analysis: Lead or support clinical performance improvement projects by analyzing unit data, identifying practice gaps, and integrating research findings to improve efficiency, quality, and patient outcomes.

Interdisciplinary Collaboration: Serve as a subject matter expert and consultant for the healthcare team, actively participating in committees and rounds to foster a culture of continuous learning, interdisciplinary communication, and professional development

Evidence-Based Practice Advocacy: Role-model clinical excellence and serve as a resource for complex patient scenarios, ensuring that all educational materials and clinical interventions reflect the most current, evidence-based nursing standards.
Able to deal effectively with patient care partners, patients, family members and physicians.
Must demonstrate excellent written/oral communication skills, organizational skills and time management skills.
Must demonstrate effectiveness in applicable computer skills – i.e Google Suite/Microsoft Office
